name: It Always Comes, On Its Own Time

description.value: Once per day, choose any effect that just resolved or is currently ongoing — yours or an enemy's — and delay it by any number of rounds you choose, up to 1 minute. It then triggers automatically at the start of that later round, exactly as it would have, and no save or ability may prevent or reduce it a second time. Nothing The Someday postpones is ever actually avoided.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Once per day: choose any effect (yours or an enemy's) that just resolved or is ongoing and delay it up to 1 minute; it then triggers automatically, unmitigable a second time" is P-CROSS: delaying/re-triggering an arbitrary effect that may belong to an enemy, with no selector anywhere in pf2e-source for deferring or re-firing an already-resolved effect on a different creature's timeline.
